content:
opsbot: ALERT: p0 incident triggered — Elevated 5xx and timeouts for customer FinEdge on Dedicated cluster eu-west-1-ded-02. service=inference-gateway, symptom=503s + gateway timeouts, rate spike from tenant finedge-prod. Links: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/d/abcd/alerts

alice (on-call): I'm on it. acked. pulling logs + top. anyone seeing related alerts in other clusters?

raj (sre): I see increased GPU utilization on ded-02 host pool nodes 5-8, memory pressure, and high connection churn. Rate from finedge-prod looks bursty — consistent with a large batch job.

maria (eng-runtime): Noted. Model workers hit OOM/restarts? Logs show repeated worker restart loops for model: unicorn-13b-quant. Worker restart count increasing every 30s.

kevin (customer-success): Kevin from CS — FinEdge reports "many internal 500s" in their app. They say traffic started after a nightly reindex that kicked off ~10:02UTC.

alice (on-call): Paging chad (engineering) & maria. I'm going to throttle finedge at the gateway to keep platform healthy while we root cause. Applying soft-QoS 50%

maria (eng-runtime): Throttle applied. Command: ```redwoodctl qos set --tenant finedge-prod --cpu 0.5 --burst 0.1 --cluster eu-west-1-ded-02``` 

opsbot: ACTION: QoS policy updated for tenant finedge-prod on eu-west-1-ded-02 by alice.

raj (sre): Good temporary step. We still need to remove noisy jobs or move customer to spare pool. Do we have capacity in ded-03?

chad (engineering): We have a small spare pool in ded-03 with different kernel optimizations. I can try migrating their active routing to ded-03. Will be disruptive for in-flight requests — suggest draining with fallback.

alice (on-call): Let's do a staged migration. maria, can you prepare a canary route? chad, stand by to trigger migration once canary passes.

maria (eng-runtime): Canary route prepared: ```routes create finedge-canary --cluster eu-west-1-ded-03 --model unicorn-13b-quant --replicas 2 --health-check /healthz``` Running health checks now.

opsbot: canary route finedge-canary passing health checks. 2/2 healthy.

chad (engineering): Initiating migration: ```redwoodctl migrate --customer finedge-prod --from eu-west-1-ded-02 --to eu-west-1-ded-03 --strategy staged --batch-size 10``` Monitoring logs.

opsbot: Migration job started (job id: mig-20260203-001).

emma (support): Notifying FinEdge that we're performing traffic migration; suggested ETA ~10 minutes. Message sent to finedge-support@finedge.com.

kevin (customer-success): FinEdge acknowledged, they confirmed the reindex job is still running but can pause if needed. Asking them to pause now.

finedge-notify-bot: Update from FinEdge: reindex paused at 10:17UTC, they will keep it paused until platform signals go-ahead.

raj (sre): Seeing decreased 5xx on ded-02 as throttling + migration proceeds. GPU/worker restarts dropping. Still some gateway timeouts — likely connection draining.

alice (on-call): After first batch moved, error rate down ~85%. Continuing. If migration completes cleanly we'll leave customer on ded-03 and mark ded-02 for postmortem and tenant isolation.

chad (engineering): Migration completed to 100%. Command output: ```mig-20260203-001: completed. moved 230/230 sessions. old routes drained.```

opsbot: Incident update: error rate for finedge-prod back to baseline on eu-west-1-ded-03. Overall cluster error rate for ded-02 normalized.

maria (eng-runtime): Root cause hypothesis: noisy neighbor - large reindex job from FinEdge saturated KV cache and GPU memory leading to OOM/restarts for unicorn-13b-quant workers. Need better per-tenant burst limits and autoscaling guardrails.

alice (on-call): Great work. I'll draft the incident summary + notify on-call rotation for handoff to SRE postmortem. Handing off to raj for follow-up and RCA.

raj (sre): Taking postmortem lead. Next steps: collect metrics (GPU mem, restarts, connection churn), config snapshot of tenant QoS, migration logs, customer reindex schedule. Planning RCA meeting tomorrow 15:00 UTC.

kevin (customer-success): I'll coordinate with FinEdge on schedule and recommend they move reindex off-peak or use a dedicated maintenance window on reserved capacity.

alice (on-call): Marking incident resolved for paging. Closing on-call shift now — handing to raj. :white_check_mark:

opsbot: INCIDENT CLOSED (paging) by alice at 1749991550. Postmortem: scheduled.
